about: One-line breaks of the games contract and its interface, each with the one test that goes red. For each: apply its edits to the file (each find occurs exactly once in the file as committed; line is where it starts; a find of several lines is one anchor, chosen where the line alone occurs more than once), run the named test alone and see it fail, restore the file byte for byte and see it pass. The whole games suite fails on each too. Forge matches --match-test against the test's name with its parentheses, so the pattern below ends in an escaped parenthesis; one ending in $ matches nothing and passes with no test run. Check that exactly one test ran. Ids: N, F, G, L, W, R, M are the creation fee's; E the ends'; P the earlier never-lines' and the interface's; C the day-30 clock's and the retirement's; A the readings' checks; X the four one-line mutants an independent read found surviving before them; H the scoring program's own shapes (test/games/shapes.json), each run through the report door; Q the Chainlink reporter's (src/games/OspexChainlinkReporter.sol); Y the deploy script's (script/DeployGames.s.sol, and Y25 in script/DeployPolygonTimelock.s.sol, whose verify the deploy calls), whose tests run on a fork and need POLYGON_RPC_URL, ETHEREUM_RPC_URL and POLYGON_LOGS_RPC_URL in the environment, with the same command.
